method: Signed Fourier Hamming perturbation plus block descendant-criticality
prior_status: Exact critical tensors were classified and critical slack was identified, but tiny point surgery showed that qualitative primitivity did not control hidden tensor structure.
new_status: A descendant-critical source obeys an explicit ratio cap near every tensor with a lower-ratio physical factor. For the six-bit point defect, any critical H/I>4 source has polynomial Hamming separation; the one-point-surgery near-tensor family is excluded for m>=5.
mathematical_delta: Proved a general ordinary-H/I near-tensor separation theorem with signed Fourier perturbation, exact physical influence transport, a rational six-bit gap, and a quantified primitivity interface.
remaining_obstacle: Extract a low-ratio physical factor or paid interface from every tensor-prime descendant-critical source, or construct a genuine critical prime family avoiding all such tests.
next_action: Test the separation inequality on near tensors whose factors have ratios approaching the critical root ratio, and seek a block-extraction criterion driven by the A052 slack identity.
